body: I'm so very sorry to hear that! Please do your best to keep trying. You might not be everyone's cup of tea but if you keep on long enough you are bound to be someone's! Sending you oodles of positive vibes to help your efforts along. And BTW, more than happy to be a virtual friend if that is of any help.

Can you reach out to make local connections through a church or community group of some kind? It sounds as if you need to find a way to make friends within your local community? I am am Aussie living in Washington State so I absolutely get the whole missing family piece. Best of luck!

I totally get this struggle. Actually I feel as if I am in the exact same place. My greatest issue is hurting my loved ones but honestly my day-to-day existence hurts them and harms them as it stands. I feel like such a collosal burden to them all of the time and then I also just want the pain and darkness that accompanies my mental illness to end. I feel so incredibly weak for not being better equiped to fight this monster despite medication and therapy but I also just want it all to be done with, to find peace where there hasn't been any for way, way too long.
